comparison_rules: Compare Phase 8 only with the retained simple benchmarks in Phase 7, not with rejected learned candidates.
Keep the four Phase 7 development folds separate from the single reserved 2026 evaluation period.
Report numerical differences descriptively; do not invent a post-hoc performance threshold or significance claim.
Do not tune, replace, recalibrate, or add a feature, cutoff, model, metric, or date in response to the reserved result.
Do not claim portfolio, trading, Shariah-compliance, whole-market, or production performance.
next_gate: If the review reproduces exactly, Step 8.8 may publish and freeze the Phase 8 conclusion without changing the procedures.
